title: CM-K230 L3/L8 and conditional L3/L6 impedance feasibility screen
target_tolerance_note: No acceptance tolerance was retrieved from the K230 guide. None is invented or used to convert near-target values into passes.

calculator_license.reason: The finite-stripline expressions and branch structure adapt the KiCad implementation; this is not asserted to be a clean-room implementation or covered by original-module MIT licensing.

scope.method: Locally evaluated primary-source documented analytical equations, with independent coarse-formula comparison

geometry_conventions.width: Finished rectangular copper width, not necessarily the artwork width after etch compensation
geometry_conventions.gap: Finished copper edge-to-edge spacing between equal-width differential traces
geometry_conventions.dielectric_gap: Copper-surface-to-copper-surface dielectric gap, excluding signal copper thickness
geometry_conventions.plane_separation: h_upper + signal_copper_thickness + h_lower; reference-plane copper is not counted twice
geometry_conventions.L3_asymmetry: Both ground planes are included. Do not model L3 as a microstrip to its closest plane.
geometry_conventions.mask: Uncoated L8 is a comparison geometry only; the design expects mask. No actual mask thickness or Dk is known.
geometry_conventions.adjacent_copper: No coplanar copper, other traces, plane apertures or carrier conductors in the analytical uniform cross section

PW_8L_1P2_70_CANDIDATE.conditional_L6: Identical mirrored dielectric distances and Dk values to L3 only if L5 is made continuous GND; this allocation alone does not fix the 1.2 mm width conflict

conditional_layer_allocation: L8 primarily power and other signals
PW_8L_1P6_70_ALTERNATIVE.allocation_approval: Not adopted; requires PDN/current-path, decoupling, return-path, escape and mechanical review

models.purpose: Finite-thickness centered stripline expression and harmonic combination of two virtual centered geometries for offset stripline
models.limitation: Homogeneous rectangular analytical model, not a solver for the actual layered core/prepreg. Finite-copper thickness is included. No numeric accuracy guarantee is asserted for this construction.

models.purpose: Uncoated single-ended L8 with finite copper correction
models.locator: Equations 11.4, 11.6, 11.15-11.18 and 11.22-11.25; normalized-width interpretation also checked against Qucs implementation
models.limitation: No solder mask, anisotropy, copper trapezoid/roughness or adjacent carrier; quasi-static only. Published fit accuracies are not assigned to this manufactured board.

models.purpose: Independent coarse SE equations and user-defined-Z0 differential coupling heuristic
models.limitation: Empirical coupling expressions, not multilayer odd/even-mode field solutions. Substitution of KiCad/HJ Z0 is an explicitly labeled screening hybrid. Finite copper enters the SE formula, but sidewall coupling is not independently solved; model error is not bounded.

uncertainty_policy.catalog_Dk: Catalog values have no supplied frequency/test-method/resin-content/lot tolerance qualification. Arithmetic midpoint is only a named nominal surrogate, never a measured effective Dk.
uncertainty_policy.moved_plane_bracket: Use symmetric h_near and symmetric h_far with uniform catalog Dk min/max to bracket geometry/material substitutions. The formula-computed interval is not a rigorous total-error or manufacturing interval.
uncertainty_policy.illustrative_sensitivity: Dk 4.0-4.8, copper 25-45 um, per-gap multipliers 0.9-1.1, and width +/-10 um are selected what-if inputs, not supplier tolerances or statistical corner limits.
uncertainty_policy.board_thickness: Catalog finished-board tolerance is not assigned to each dielectric ply. The published 50% and 70% copper-density constructions must not be blended.
uncertainty_policy.frequency: No operating frequency or edge-rise-time model is assigned. Need design Dk/Df versus frequency plus DDR edge spectrum for final impedance, loss and delay analysis.
uncertainty_policy.mask: Need actual cured top/side/field thickness and Dk; L8 mask can reduce impedance. Conditional all-space-fill endpoint is a loose ideal-media limit, not a real mask prediction.
uncertainty_policy.via: All-through-via topology remains; no via impedance, stub resonance, return-via or transition delay result is provided. Plane antipads and interrupted references require actual geometry.
uncertainty_policy.targets: 50 and 100 ohm are nominal targets, with no adopted percentage tolerance

spacing_sources.figure_rules: 2H within byte; 3H from DQ/DM to DQS pair, byte to CA group, CA to CK pair, supply/Vref separation
spacing_sources.three_W_ambiguity: Text says 3W without defining edge-to-edge or center-to-center. Provisional envelope assumes the more conservative 3W edge gap; this is an engineering screen, not an assertion that the guide defined it that way.
spacing_sources.H_ambiguity: Figure does not specify offset-stripline H convention. Provisional L3/L6 envelope uses larger copper-surface-to-plane gap; solver/crosstalk review must resolve the actual geometry.
spacing_sources.pair_gap: Intrapair DQS/CK spacing is independently chosen for 100 ohm. Do not apply the neighbor-to-pair 3H label as a mandatory gap between complementary traces.

additional_primary_sources.source_authority: Existing audited fabrication proposal; catalog entries 13 and 1

additional_primary_sources.purpose: Coated microstrip requires mask Dk and thickness
Both references, finite copper and inversion dimension conventions
Same-process controlled-impedance coupons and measured verification

stop_condition: Useful source-backed numerical feasibility established for two existing catalog stacks. No further catalog search, custom vendor claim, CAD promotion or external action.
